title: The defining diagonal lift with ordinary proper comparison
statement: For finite commutative A, proper f:X -> S and an isomorphism i:X ~= P1_S over S, diagonalLift equals the component of ordinaryProperForgetComparison for the diagonal, followed by ordinary diagonal direct image of constantComparison inverse, followed by inverse exchange for the diagonal square. This is the defining formula, retaining the full inverse coefficient isomorphism.

source.place: The equation M = Rp2_* Delta_* M, the diagonal is a section for either projection, and substitution of canonical pullback counits before applying direct image.

proof.text: Unfold diagonalLift. Its defining body uses the canonical ordinary endpoint wrapper and the intact inverse constantComparison, so both sides are reflexively equal.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalLift_eq_ordinaryProperForget
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f) :
    diagonalLift A f i hi =
      (ordinaryProperForgetComparison A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).hom.app
          (derivedTensorUnit (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePushforward A (TraceDiagonalDatum.diagonal f)).map
          (constantComparison A i).inv ≫
        (properExchange A (diagonalSquare f i hi)).inv.app
          (ordinaryFiniteUnit A (ProjectiveLine S))
